changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. The Clearfield City Council voted 4-0 on September 8, 2026 to adopt a 180-day moratorium prohibiting data center development in the city (through approximately March 7, 2027) while officials study whether special zoning guidelines are warranted. No data center proposal was found to be barred outright by the action; a pending zoning-determination request at the Freeport Center (Building J8) prompted the pause. No extension or replacement was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.
changes.after: Signed Ordinance 2026-13 records September 8 adoption, four affirmative votes including King, and Thompson absent. It states 180 days from its effective date unless terminated earlier. The five-page text does not specify that date or include an express operative prohibition section; its title, findings and city adoption notice describe a temporary data-center land-use regulation.
